data.body: Landed as Gerrit change 1607 (merged, main commit 6778a48956) with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1. Authored text suffixes (.py/.md/.json/.toml/.yaml/.yml) now fail closed on a UTF-8 decode error while all other suffixes stay tolerated as binary; diagnostic excerpts and paths are escaped for non-printable characters and capped at 200 chars with a truncation marker. Nine new behavioral tests; six of them verified RED against the pre-fix script, the three binary-tolerance cases pass both before and after (behavior preserved). Gates: make lint, make typecheck (499 files), 135 vocabulary-related tests pass.
